title: Routing Intelligence — spoke-profile-aware dispatch + proactive cross-spoke suggestions
summary: Allow ideas to be delivered to one or multiple spokes in one action. IdeaBank retention toggle (default: keep) prevents the idea being consumed on delivery. Orko guides spoke selection during intake.
why_bother: Single-spoke delivery is limiting for cross-team ideas. IdeaBank retention means delivery is a copy, not a move — ideas persist locally as reference.
goal: User selects one or more target spokes during idea creation; idea delivered to all selected spokes; original retained in IdeaBank if toggle on.
scope: Minder UI: multi-select spoke picker during idea creation and detail view
IdeaBank retention toggle — default: keep (opt-out, not opt-in)
Spoke validation against registry for each selected target before delivery
Delivery to multiple destinations with per-spoke success/failure reporting
Orko intake: awareness of multi-target during conversation
constraints: All selected spokes must validate against registry before creation
Multi-delivery reports partial failures per spoke
IdeaBank retention is default — user must explicitly opt out

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Feature lug from Minder: routing intelligence for multi-spoke idea delivery
_behavior_directive.processing_agent: Framework team reviews; Minder implements UI + schema changes
_behavior_directive.expected_outcome: Ideas can target multiple spokes in one delivery action with local retention option

description: Two capabilities: (1) When a lug targets multiple spokes, Ozi reads each spoke's profile (focus, audience, purpose) from the hub registry and drafts a spoke-appropriate message — framework gets functional notes, website gets marketing framing. Ask-once: if profile is missing, Ozi asks focus/goal and persists to registry. (2) Proactive cross-spoke suggestions: when a major enhancement (impact >= 8) completes, Ozi checks the spoke map and surfaces relevant actions (website update, LinkedIn post) rather than waiting for human to remember. Trivial work is silent. Hub registry is the sole source of spoke awareness — requires spoke profile schema extension.
perceive: Hub registry stores basic spoke metadata (id, name, version, status, one_liner). No focus/audience/purpose/external_facing profile fields exist. Ozi has no basis for drafting spoke-appropriate messages or distinguishing framework from website audience. No proactive threshold logic — Ozi only acts on direct asks. Multi-target lugs have targets[] field (from lug schema) but Ozi ignores spoke profiles.
execute: 1. Extend hub registry spoke schema: add focus (str), audience (internal|external), purpose (str), communication_style (str) fields to registry/incoming/{spoke_id}.json. 2. Ask-once protocol in Ozi: when dispatching to a spoke with incomplete profile, ask 'What is the focus and goal of spoke {id}?' — persist answer to registry. 3. Multi-target dispatch: for lugs with targets[] list, read profile per target, draft tailored message per spoke. Framework = functional/behavioral framing. External spokes = audience-appropriate framing. 4. Proactive threshold: after completing a lug with impact >= 8, Ozi checks spoke map for relevant cross-spoke actions. Surfaces max 2 suggestions with one-line rationale. User accepts or dismisses — Ozi creates lug if accepted. 5. Update 9d (closeout spoke registry) to include new profile fields.
verify: Hub registry spoke entry includes focus/audience/purpose fields. Dispatching lug to [framework, website] produces two distinct messages with different framing. Spoke with no profile triggers ask-once question, not silent failure. Completing impact=9 lug surfaces at most 2 cross-spoke suggestions. Completing impact=4 lug produces no unsolicited suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: Hub registry spoke schema includes focus, audience, purpose, communication_style
Ask-once: incomplete spoke profile triggers one question, answer persisted
Multi-target lug dispatch drafts per-spoke message using spoke profile
Proactive suggestions surface only for impact >= 8 completions
Trivial work (impact < 8) produces no unsolicited cross-spoke suggestions
User accept/dismiss flow creates or skips the suggested lug
